meta.name: DocPilot Phase 4 benchmark — classic-vs-agentic comparison
meta.note: The same question set runs through both pipelines (Phase 1 direct fast path vs Phase 2 agentic loop with Phase 3 GitHub tool). docs-answerable rows carry gold key facts (verbatim corpus phrasing) + gold source files for retrieval recall and citation scoring; live-state rows expect the tool to fire and a cited live answer; neither rows expect the verbatim 'I don't know' refusal.

questions.question: How do I declare a query parameter with a default value in FastAPI?
gold_key_facts: As query parameters are not a fixed part of a path, they can be optional and can have default values
default values of skip=0 and limit=10
questions.note: Reuses tool_necessity td01 context; answer must explain defaults.

questions.question: How do I declare the type of a path parameter in FastAPI?
gold_key_facts: item_id is declared to be an int

questions.question: What is the response_model parameter used for in FastAPI?
gold_key_facts: use the path operation decorator parameter response_model instead of the return type
You can use the response_model parameter in any of the path operations

questions.question: When do FastAPI background tasks run relative to the response?
gold_key_facts: You can define background tasks to be run after returning a response

questions.question: How do I send a request body with my FastAPI endpoint?
gold_key_facts: send it as a request body

questions.question: Does declaring a default value on a query parameter make it optional or required?
gold_key_facts: When you declare a default value for non-path parameters, then it is not required
questions.note: Corpus-verbatim fact from query-params defaults section.

questions.question: Why must the /users/me path operation be declared before the /users/{user_id} one?
gold_key_facts: Because path operations are evaluated in order
you need to make sure that the path for /users/me is declared before the one for /users/{user_id}
questions.note: Corpus-verbatim facts from path-params order note.

questions.question: How do I declare cookie parameters in FastAPI?
gold_key_facts: You can define Cookie parameters the same way you define Query and Path parameters
